implementation.gap8: verbatim production functions extracted from pulp-frontnet/main.c
implementation.stm32: production flowdeck_obstacle_link.c directly included by host harness
implementation.pixels: native 160x160 8-bit grayscale PNG samples; no resize or filtering
implementation.selection: production accumulated 66,667 us vision deadline applied to saved frames

limitations: The Wi-Fi recording omitted on-board camera frames; non-nominal selected gaps cannot reproduce the flow pairs processed in flight.
No measured obstacle world coordinate or dimensions are present, so absolute range/bearing error cannot be scored from these files alone.
Gyroscope samples were not logged; yaw rate is derived from logged yaw.
